input: Find general day camps, church day camps, Parks & Recreation camps and summer childcare summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Johnson City, Erwin, Jonesborough, Elizabethton, Greeneville and Newport, Tennessee. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Johnson City Tennessee summer camp 2026 parks recreation YMCA church

candidates.name: Johnson City Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 offerings included Jump Start JC, Carver summer camp and specialty camps.

candidates.name: Coalition for Kids
candidates.note: Free, grant-funded 2026 summer program at its Susannah Street main campus.

candidates.name: Boys & Girls Club of Johnson City / Washington County
candidates.note: 2026 themed summer program with learning and recreation; summer hours 7:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m.

candidates.name: East Tennessee State University
candidates.note: 2026 Renaissance camps for grades 1–6, teen STEM programs and additional sports, music and health-science camps.

candidates.name: Central Church of Christ of Johnson City
candidates.note: 2026 VBS ran May 31–June 3, 6–8 p.m., with dinner available beforehand.

candidates.name: Unicoi County Family YMCA
candidates.note: Summer day camps include swimming, field trips, sports, STEM and arts and crafts.

candidates.name: McKinney Center
candidates.note: 2026 summer offerings included morning Artsploration and afternoon pottery camps.

candidates.name: Fauna Forest Farm
candidates.note: Summer forest and farm programs include Earth, Art & Heart Skills for girls ages 5–14.

candidates.name: Boys & Girls Club of Elizabethton/Carter County
candidates.note: Summer youth program accepts children beginning at age 5 after completing kindergarten.

candidates.name: Elizabethton City Schools
candidates.note: Extended School Program serves pre-K–grade 8 with summer educational activities and physical exercise.

candidates.name: Greene County YMCA
candidates.note: Weekly summer day camp for children entering kindergarten through eighth grade.

candidates.name: Boys & Girls Club of Greeneville & Greene County
candidates.note: Summer youth program includes meals and enrichment; activities include farm day-camp visits.

candidates.name: Greeneville City Schools
candidates.note: Announced 2026 Summer Learning Camp registration opening April 20.

candidates.name: Rural Resources
candidates.note: 2026 Farm Day Camps included half-day Lil Sprouts ages 4–6 and full-day Explorers sessions.

candidates.name: First United Methodist Church of Newport
candidates.note: Hosted free Camp in the Community June 8–12, 2026, with Holston Camp and Retreat Ministries.

candidates.name: West End Baptist Church of Newport
candidates.note: Official church website lists its 2026 Vacation Bible School.
